comment: Public reference photos of real courts for the photo-match mode (Phase 5). tools/fetch-reference.mjs downloads them into reference/photos/ (gitignored). `points` pair image positions (u across, v down, 0-1) with court positions (metres, sim axes: x across, y up, z along, net at z = 0); tools/photo-solve.ts fits `cam` to them. `aspect` is the photo's width / height.
